start_ray_cluster_head_and_workers: start a Ray cluster head node and worker nodes on SLURM using submitit with gang scheduling
start_ray_cluster_head: start the head node of a Ray cluster on SLURM with specified resource requirements
start_ray_cluster_workers: start an array of worker nodes for an existing Ray cluster head on SLURM
shutdown_ray_cluster: cancel all SLURM jobs and clean up the rendezvous directory for a Ray cluster
find_free_port: find an available TCP port on the local machine with an optional preferred port
